svg.title: Gains from trade and the equal-wealth target

cc:Work.dc:title: Gains from trade and the equal-wealth target
cc:Work.dc:description: The coloured curves pass through the initial endowment. The target E lies below both initial curves, reducing Alice’s utility and increasing Benjamin’s; it is outside the improvement lens.
